answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The pearl is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
